name: Spirit of Lord Emthoro

facts.text: Level 77, 30,000 health. Takes no damage unless the attacker is within 440 of his spawn; casts Lifedrain Pulse; orc and zombie servants join him.

story: Lord Emthoro held Inishail before the war, the garrison thinks, though no record names him; only his spirit remains, and his spirit has not given up his land. It cannot be harmed by anyone who will not stand on it. Arrows and spells from the edge of his ground pass through him; only those who step onto the ground where he stands can reach him. He pulses with a drain that takes the life of everyone who does, and the orcs and dead of Inishail come to serve him when he calls. He was a lord. He still expects his tenants to come to him.
legend: He takes no damage from anyone more than a short step from his spawn point, so everyone, casters too, stands on his ground. His lifedrain pulse hits everyone there; heal through it. Orc and zombie servants come; kill them. Ranged who stay back do nothing at all.

aggro: You stand on my land. Kneel.

lairEntry: A lord's ground. Step onto it to face him.

phases.text: Lord Emthoro's tenants come to his call!

atmosphere.realmFirstKill: The Spirit of Lord Emthoro rests. Inishail is free.

briefing: emthoro only takes damage from people standing next to his spawn. everyone in close
